ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The main body in the figure is a sugar-like six-membered oxygen-containing ring, fused on the right side with a cyclic acetal/oxonium structure containing two oxygen atoms; this right-side central carbon bears a positive charge and is connected to a methyl group. On the lower left there is a solid wedge bond connected to an AcO substituent, at the bottom there is a dashed wedge bond connected to an O-substituent, and on the upper left there is a dashed wedge bond indicating the methyl substitution direction. Above the image there is additionally an H–O–Ar fragment, indicating an independent aromatic phenol molecule; curved arrows are ignored according to the problem statement. Reasoning: Treat Ar–OH as an independent phenol component, written as Oc1ccccc1. AcO is expanded as CC(=O)O–. Select the fused-ring numbering according to the given method and specify chirality by solid/dashed wedge bonds; the sugar/oxonium fragment can be written as CC(=O)O[C@@H]1[C@@H](OC(C)=O)[C@H](C)O[C@@H]2O[C+](C)O[C@@H]21. Then connect it with the independent phenol by a dot to obtain the complete SMILES.

method.method_draft: First visually transcribe the non-arrow structure into a molecular graph: expand the sugar-like ring, its acetoxy, methoxy, methyl, and fused positively charged acetal substituents, and treat the Ar–OH as a separate phenol molecule. Choose a consistent atom numbering through the fused ring system, then assign each stereocenter from the drawn solid/dashed bonds. Encode the sugar/cation fragment in chiral SMILES, append the independent phenol fragment after a dot, and verify the abbreviations and charge give CC(=O)O[C@@H]1[C@@H](OC(C)=O)[C@H](C)O[C@@H]2O[C+](C)O[C@@H]21.Oc1ccccc1.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中主体是一个糖样六元含氧环，右侧与一个含两个氧原子的环状缩醛/氧鎓结构稠合；该右侧中心碳带正电荷并连有一个甲基。左下方有一个实楔键连到 AcO 取代基，底部有一个虚楔键连到 O-取代基，左上方有一个虚楔键表示甲基取代方向。图像上方另有 H–O–Ar 片段，表示一个独立的芳香酚分子；弯箭头按题意忽略。推理：将 Ar–OH 作为独立苯酚组分，写作 Oc1ccccc1。AcO 展开为 CC(=O)O–。按给定方法选定稠合环编号并由实/虚楔键指定手性，糖/氧鎓片段可写为 CC(=O)O[C@@H]1[C@@H](OC(C)=O)[C@H](C)O[C@@H]2O[C+](C)O[C@@H]21。再与独立苯酚用点号连接，得到完整 SMILES。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription is the natural single route for this image-grounded chemistry item; it relies on identifying each drawn fragment and encoding it in one connected stereochemical SMILES plus the separate phenol fragment.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the drawn transition-state structure while ignoring the curved arrows: a substituted pyranose-like ring with a ring oxygen at the top, stereochemical wedge/dash substituents, an AcO group on the lower-left carbon, a methoxy substituent shown downward, a methyl substituent on one stereocenter, a fused/dioxolenium-like right-hand cyclic acetal containing O atoms and a positively charged carbon bearing CH3, and a separate Ar–OH/phenol group hydrogen-bonded above.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the task is to choose/write the SMILES of the shown transition-state structure and to ignore the arrows; no other text supplies chemical content.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use chemical abbreviation expansion and SMILES conventions: AcO means acetoxy, CC(=O)O–; Ar attached to OH is phenyl phenol, encoded as Oc1ccccc1; the circled plus is encoded as [C+]; disconnected species are separated by a dot; wedge/dash bonds determine the @/@@ stereochemical descriptors when assigning the ring atom order.
